content: Ate oatmeal. Ran 3km. Felt easy.
Work was boring. Did 20 pushups. Completed all tasks on time.
AMAZING run today! Hit 5km for the first time. Felt like I could fly. This is working!
Rest day. Watched a movie. Ate pizza.
Ran 4km. Legs feel strong. Thinking about signing up for a 10k race.
Did yoga. Ate healthy meal.
Rest day. Read a book about running form.
Pushed for 7km today. Shin splints hurt a bit but I powered through. I'm getting stronger!
Ate a salad. Completed coding project. Feeling productive.
Knee feels weird when I walk down stairs. Ignored it and did squats anyway. No pain during the workout.
Ran 6km. Ignored the weird knee feeling. Pushed through it. Mind over matter!
Ate breakfast. Work meeting went well.
Knee feels stiff in the morning. Still ran 5km. It'll get better with time.
Rest day. Knee still feels off but I'm sure it's nothing.
FUCK. Sharp pain in right knee at mile 1. Had to walk home. Limping now. This is bad.
Can't walk without pain. Mood is trash. I hate this. Why did I push so hard?
Ate pizza. Did nothing. Knee still hurts. Feeling demotivated.
Skipped all exercise. Knee is better but still hurts when I bend it. Frustrated.
Went to doctor. They said it's likely 'Runner's Knee' from overuse. Need to rest.
Ate healthy. Work was fine. Knee still bothering me.
Read about Runner's Knee online. Feeling anxious about recovery time.
Read about 'Runner's Knee' in detail. Realized I increased mileage too fast in Week 2. Need to strengthen glutes and quads.
Started glute bridge exercises. Knee feels more stable. Learned my lesson about gradual progression.
Ate well. Did glute exercises. No running. Being patient with recovery.
Knee feeling better. Did light stretching. Still no running but staying active with strength work.
Did glute bridges today. Knee feels stable. Going to stick to Zone 2 cardio only when I return. Learned: gradual progression prevents injury.
Work was busy. Ate lunch. Knee improving daily.
First walk-jog test. 2km total, mostly walking. Knee handled it well. Feeling optimistic.
Ate breakfast. Completed work tasks. Recovery going well.
Planning next week: Max 3km runs, focus on form, add glute strength work. Won't make the same mistake twice.
